mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as capital becomes cheaper to deploy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of observations where FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated housing starts (HOUST > 550) signal robust consumer demand for residential construction, increasing equity valuations through higher GDP growth expectations and positive sector momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST > 550.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 94) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO > 94.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 5%) reflect tight labor markets and strong consumer spending, leading to elevated corporate profit margins and positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL ≤ 220) signal a stable monetary environment that reduces equity risk premiums, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% and CPIAUCSL ≤ 220.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1 percentage point rise over 3 months) signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 93.5) signals immediate manufacturing momentum, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through short-term sector rotation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO > 93.5.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% YoY) indicates sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through elevated corporate earnings forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% quarterly.
